verdict.rationale: Stripe does convert between fiat and stablecoins, but only inside other flows. The onramp lets customers buy and exchange crypto with fiat, stablecoin payments settle as local fiat, and Connect stablecoin payouts have Stripe handle the fiat-to-USDC conversion. Nothing in the evidence shows a standalone conversion API with quotes and executed conversions, and the community note on fees and delays is too vague to count as a dispute. Missing for 10: a first-class quote/convert API endpoint, stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion, documented exchange rates and conversion fees, documented settlement times for conversions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
